summary: Keep MANAGE_ORGANIZATION_AUTH the same in platform gateway and controller. AAP 2.5/2.6 still expose per-service APIs for compatibility but will remove them, so move integrations to gateway endpoints like /api/gateway/v1, /api/controller/v2 and /api/eda/v1.
questions: Should MANAGE_ORGANIZATION_AUTH match in gateway and controller?
Will direct automation controller API access be removed?
What is the API URL for automation controller in AAP 2.6?
Do my 2.4 API integrations need to change for 2.6?

answer_card.title: MANAGE_ORGANIZATION_AUTH and API access
answer_card.answer_md:
- `MANAGE_ORGANIZATION_AUTH` (*Organization Admins Can Manage Users and Teams*) exists in both gateway and controller; the controller value is imported on upgrade. Keep both values the same.
- Direct service APIs still work in 2.5/2.6 but will be removed. Use gateway-exposed endpoints:
  - Gateway: `https://<gateway>/api/gateway/v1`
  - Controller: `https://<gateway>/api/controller/v2`
  - EDA: `https://<gateway>/api/eda/v1`
